training_profile_collisions.theorem: Five common-baseline nodes and two binary whole-event responses have at most four training spatial signatures. Some pair has identical training P and Q in every realization.
training_profile_collisions.indistinguishable_pair_witness: For compatible diagonal H=diag(h), choose any duplicate pair i,j and 0<a<min(h_i,h_j)/2. Hprime=H+a*z_ij*z_ij^T-2a*(e_i*e_i^T+e_j*e_j^T) is a nonnegative tree with an internal pair and identical training outputs.
training_profile_collisions.scope: Uniform training identifiability over the compatible model class only; does not imply the actual true tree always fails or that both validation events cannot separate the pair.

limitations: Randomized exploration control, not a new WZZT price optimizer.
Eight independent response paths per law conditional on fixed load/noiseless linear voltage.
Two planner draws do not exhaust all price ties; no posthoc replacement of chosen prices.
Mean and stochastic objectives have independently sampled tie representatives; their difference also includes location draws.
Zero and weak weights retained in the declared separate all-participate controls.
Historical whole-family possibility is not topology probability or a guarantee for greedy search.
